title: SC09-T1 — the payoff (SH01, SH02a, SH02b, SH03, SH04, SH05)
line: Wait. That is your ex-wife? / I am sorry, I just have to ask. / What do you use on your skin? You look amazing.
motionPlan: the woman, unsettled, turns to Peter and asks; Peter still staring after Michelle → the woman hurries along the walkway after Michelle, catching up to her cart, the camera backing away in front of her → the woman hurries along the walkway after Michelle, catching up to her cart, the camera backing away in front of her → Michelle turns her head to the woman, her lips closed, the corners of her mouth curving up warm and serene, saying nothing → Michelle turns her cart and walks away down the walkway, unhurried; the woman stops, left behind → Peter stands alone at the end-cap behind his cart, small in the bright aisle, his hand slipping off the handle
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
